plain_english_revision: The amendment requires that elective Bible study courses meet the same academic standards as other electives, limits their display to course duration only, and ensures students can fulfill grade requirements without taking these specific courses.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment supports ensuring that elective Bible study courses in public schools meet the same academic rigor as other electives and are displayed only during course duration.
